title: Ecclesiastes
html_source:
The Ecclesiastes is an Old Testament book consisting of reflection on the vanity of human life, traditionally attributed to Solomon. The book is in the form of an autobiography telling of his investigation of the meaning of life and the best way of life, proclaiming the actions of man to be vain, empty, meaningless, and temporary.

The book of Ecclesiastes seems to reflect Stephen’s downward attitude in this chapter.
